title: Arrival in Sidom
summary: Alma and Amulek depart the city and arrive in Sidom, where they find the people cast out of Ammonihah. The people tell them what happened to their families and themselves.
characters: the people cast out of Ammonihah

explicit_facts.text: Alma and Amulek were commanded to leave the city and departed for Sidom.
In Sidom, they found people cast out of Ammonihah and stoned for believing Alma's words.
The people related what had happened to their wives, children, and themselves, and spoke of their deliverance.
